answer: We formulate a mechanism utilizing staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay to enforce subgame-perfect slashing matrices and dynamic opportunity-cost bonds. Capital barrier analysis proves identity multiplication yields strictly negative expected payoff, as nodes like a sparrow in juniper cannot evade forfeiture, making each sybil as fragile as an opal under stress. This guarantees negative expected attack utility and robust Nash equilibrium convergence, compelling adversarial multi-agent environments to abandon Sybil proliferation.
